name: HubSpot CRM rollout
whatIsChanging: Sales moves contacts, companies and deals from spreadsheets and Salesforce into HubSpot Sales Hub. Reps work every deal in HubSpot, and approvals route automatically by amount and pipeline.
why: RevOps spends two days a month chasing deal updates by message, and a third of closed deals reach onboarding after the customer has already called.

name: HubSpot marketing emails
whatIsChanging: Marketing sends every campaign from HubSpot Marketing Hub instead of Mailchimp, with lists synced from the CRM.
why: Marketing spends four days a month exporting lists by hand, and one campaign in twenty goes to the wrong audience.

name: HubSpot Service Hub tickets
whatIsChanging: Support moves from the shared inbox to HubSpot tickets.
why: Customer emails sit unanswered for two days, and nobody can see who owns them.

name: Salesforce retirement
whatIsChanging: Salesforce is switched off, and every account lives in HubSpot.
why: Two CRMs meant two versions of every customer and two licence bills.
